# Salamandra

> Open, community-driven 3D-printed FPV aircraft platform. The reasoning is the product:
> every decision carries its rationale, source and provenance tag (`[M]`/`[D]`/`[E]`/`[I]`).
> Derived values are rerunnable; measured inputs retain provenance; unresolved assumptions remain visible.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/guide/01-getting-started/): The shortest path from zero to a working model
- [How to read this repository](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/guide/02-how-to-read/): Folder map and traceability flow
- [Architecture](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/guide/03-architecture/): How research, decisions, gaps, tests and calculations feed each other
- [Drawings and SVG workflow](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/guide/06-drawings/): Generated A3 design-review sheets and their authority boundary
- [Glossary](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/guide/04-glossary/): Confidence tags, identifiers, signs and key terms
- [Contributing](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/guide/05-contributing/): Order of value of contributions and the workflow

## Design

- [Salamandra design](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/salamandra/): The forward-swept flying wing reference design
- [Design guide v0.22](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/salamandra/design-guide/): The v0.4.0 controlling CAD and engineering specification
- [Design guide justification](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/salamandra/design-guide-justification/): Why every number is what it is
- [Open points](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/salamandra/design-guide-open-points/): What still constrains the design

## Reference

- [Decision record (ADR)](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/decisions/): One file per decision: context, alternatives, consequences
- [Research threads](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/research/): What was searched, found, and with what sources
- [Gap register](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/gaps/): What we do not know and how it gets closed
- [Experimental program](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/tests/): The tests that turn estimates into measurements
- [Calculations](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/calculations/): Validated, rerunnable analysis scripts
- [Reproduction guide](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/calculations/reproduction-guide/): Commands and validation discipline
- [Objectives and requirements](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/reference/00-objectives-and-requirements/): The Phase-0 specification
- [Current release v0.4.0](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/reference/11-release-v04/): Authority, migration rules, released values and remaining gates
- [Phase-1 plan](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salmandra/reference/03-phase-1-plan/): Geometry and stability work plan
